risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is not a party to any material litigation. Management and legal advisors do not expect the ultimate outcome of any pending litigation to have a significant adverse effect on the company's financial condition or operating results.

risks.title: Reputation

risks.title: Capital
